name: Champion Iron Limited
description: Champion Iron is a high-purity iron ore producer operating the Bloom Lake Mining Complex near Fermont, Quebec, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Quebec Iron Ore Inc. The open-pit operation runs two concentrators with a combined 15 million tonne per year nameplate capacity, producing a low-contaminant 66.2% iron ore concentrate. The company also owns Rana Gruber ASA, a producing hematite and magnetite iron ore operation in Nordland, Norway.
